summary: OptMem provides a lightweight, plug-and-play mechanism to give AI agents permanent long-term memory using minimal prompt overhead (426 tokens), enabling persistent context across sessions.
usecases: Maintaining consistent user persona and preferences in long-running AI assistants
Enabling multi-turn conversations without context loss across sessions
Reducing token costs while preserving agent memory in deployment
ideas: Combine with vector databases for scalable persistent memory
Adapt for code agents to remember past debugging sessions
Use as a foundation for autonomous agents that learn from past interactions
